# Data Source: identitynow_connector

Use this data source to look up a connector by script name. It works for built-in and custom connectors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_connector" "active_directory" {
  script_name = "active-directory"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `script_name` (String) Script name of the connector.

### Read-Only

- `application_xml` (String) Application XML of the connector.
- `class_name` (String) Connector class name.
- `connector_metadata_json` (String) UI metadata of the connector as a JSON object.
- `correlation_config_xml` (String) Correlation config XML of the connector.
- `direct_connect` (Boolean) Whether sources of the connector are direct connect sources.
- `file_upload` (Boolean) Whether sources of the connector are file upload sources.
- `id` (String) Connector ID, the same as `script_name`.
- `name` (String) Connector name.
- `source_config_xml` (String) Source config XML of the connector.
- `status` (String) Connector status.
- `type` (String) Connector type.
